exercises.question: Which marker accepts the first claim and introduces a limiting caveat ('that said')?
options: El contrato indefinido aporta estabilidad. Por el contrario, exige planificación económica.
El contrato indefinido aporta estabilidad. Por lo tanto, exige planificación económica.
El contrato indefinido aporta estabilidad. Ahora bien, exige planificación económica.

exercises.sentence: El departamento técnico creció este año; el equipo comercial, en ____, redujo su plantilla.
exercises.english: The technical department grew this year; the commercial team, on the other hand, reduced its staff.

exercises.sentence: El salario mínimo aumentó este año; no obstante, la brecha salarial sigue siendo amplia.
options: The minimum wage fell this year; nevertheless, the pay gap remains wide.
The minimum wage rose this year; consequently, the pay gap remains wide.
The minimum wage rose this year; nevertheless, temporary contracts became permanent.
The minimum wage rose this year; nevertheless, the pay gap remains wide.

exercises.sentence: La reestructuración no eliminó puestos; por el ____, permitió crear nuevas vacantes.
exercises.english: The restructuring did not eliminate jobs; on the contrary, it made it possible to create new vacancies.
exercises.hint: last word of por el ___ (direct reversal)

exercises.question: In the interview, which contrast does the researcher draw between sectors regarding remote work?
options: Professional and administrative services often offer schedule flexibility, whereas retail, logistics and in-person service still require physical presence.
Retail and logistics offer the highest schedule flexibility, whereas administrative offices require full-time attendance.
Both professional services and in-person retail have replaced physical presence with hybrid work.

exercises.question: According to the researcher, what happens when an organisation invests more in continuous training during a restructuring?
options: It needs to expand subcontracting and raise temporary hiring.
It can stop negotiating salaries through collective bargaining.
It tends to rely less on dismissals and achieve higher medium-term productivity.

exercises.question: Why does the researcher say updating the minimum wage is not enough on its own?
options: Because it does not solve structural issues like the pay gap or pay transparency.
Because it lowers the income floor for vulnerable workers in smaller sectors.
Because it prevents companies from offering permanent contracts to new staff.

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: Muchos compañeros de mi facultad temen que sea imposible conciliar los estudios con un contrato temporal.

options: Es difícil, es verdad. Ahora bien, algunas empresas ofrecen horarios parciales que facilitan la inserción laboral.
Es difícil, es verdad. Por lo tanto, algunas empresas ofrecen horarios parciales que facilitan la inserción laboral.
Es difícil, es verdad. Además, algunas empresas ofrecen horarios parciales que facilitan la inserción laboral.

exercises.english: The restructuring ended this year; nevertheless, staff turnover remains high.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses *conciliar* accurately in a workplace context?
options: La nueva política busca conciliar la nómina con la automatización industrial.
La nueva política busca conciliar un despido con la reestructuración fiscal.
La nueva política busca conciliar la jornada laboral con la vida familiar.
